about: ORGAN's look against the Python kit: the `left` fight drawn with its real look and kit/fighters/base.py's Look for FLUTE (every hook of both spied, as look_flute does); the VS card alone on milestone 1's noise image with ORGAN on either side; its title hooks; its sprites

cards.call: hashlib.sha256(title.draw(noise, frame / 30).tobytes()), noise = studio/reference/frames/flute_vs_trombone/title/noise.png; left: the fighter on side 0, right: on side 1

cfg_keys_note: the roster keys the kit's Look class reads from self.cfg (m3parts.cfg_keys): the look takes them from setup_as's cfg and names exactly these in cfg_summary (EUPHONIUM's copies draw it with another fighter's numbers)
frame_columns: hull calls: [points, vertices, sum of x, sum of y]
hook_note: a hook call is '<side>.<hook>'; state adds '(ball,phase)', ball, ball_sprite and hides_hp add '(ball)'; hooks_build leaves out rope
